item.tib: bdud mo srog gi gzer bu
item.coloph: gsas mkhar spyi spungs mdel kha las/ bde 'gro gsang yum las bya la/ bye brag rim pa mang lags kyang*/ bdud mo'i srog gi gzer bu 'di/ kun gyi yang snying bcud phyung yin/ rim nas rim par brgyud nas su/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' yis/ cha lag thams cad gter la sbas/ gsang mdos rgyan mdos zlog mdos gsum/ man ngag zab thig yang this (thig) gsum/ 'khor lo gsang sgrub khol bu gsum/ de rnams gsang brag rgya bor sbas/ sbyin sreg skong ba las kha gsum/ lde mig sgrom bu bya thabs gsum/ rnil gyi mdzo lde yu bor sbas/ bdud mo'i srog gi gzer bu 'di/ ra sang khod ram nyid la gnang / de yis bdag la brgyud pa'o/ zhes 'chi medagatsug phud kyi las mkhan/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i phyag cha/ stag la me 'bar gyi brnag pa/ dbal gsas gsang ba'i las mtha'/ g.yung drung bon gyi bka' srung legs so//

item.coloph: gsas mkhar spyi spungs mdel kha la/ bde 'gro gsang yum las byang las/ bye brag rim pa mang lags kyang / bdud mo srog gi gzer bu las/ bye brag rim pa mang lags kyang / bdud mo srog gi gzer bu 'di/ kun gyi yang snying bcud phyung zhing / rim nas rim par brgyud nas su/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' yis/ cha lag thams cad gter du bzhag/ gsang mdos rgyal mdos bzlog mdos gsum/ man ngag zab thig yang snying gsum/ 'khor lo gsang sgrab khol bu gsum/ de rnams gsang brag rgya bor sbas/ sbyin sreg bskang (skong) ba la gsum/ lde mig sgrol bu bya thabs gsum/ rnil gyi mdzod sde yu bor sbas/ bdud mo srog gi gzer bu 'di/ ra sangs khod ram nyid la gnang*/ de yis bdag la brgyud pa'o/ zhes 'chi med gtsug phud kyi las mkhan/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i phyag cha/ stag la me 'bar gyi brnag pa/ dbal gsas gsang ba'i las mtha'/ g.yung drung bon gyi bka' srung lags so//
